scope: fanPressure BC verification, exact operating-point class (EXPERTISE_CURRICULUM.md E4 stage (a), Amendment 1). Stage (b) manufacturer-datasheet is NOT this rung.

geometry.kind: 2D planar channel, x streamwise, y across, z empty

R_exact_note: R = 12 nu L / (h^3 t) = 12*1.5e-5*2.0/(1e-6*1e-3) [ (m2/s2)/(m3/s) ], plane Poiseuille, kinematic pressure

grid.ratio_redirect_note: analyse_t1c.gci is imported frozen; its module-level R_REFINE (1.6) is redirected to 1.5 IN-PROCESS ONLY by a restoring context manager (T10aR in_tree precedent), because integer cell counts across h force r=1.5 (8/12/18); the redirect and its restoration are proved by the selftest

A.note: dp(Q) = 0.081 - 1.2e12 Q^2 [m2/s2, Q in m3/s]; operating point 1.2e12 Q^2 + 3.6e5 Q - 0.081 = 0, discriminant (7.2e5)^2 exact, Q* = 1.5e-7 exactly; U_m = 0.015 m/s, Re_h = 10

B.note: dp(Q) = 0.048 - 1.2e12 Q^2; discriminant (6.0e5)^2 exact, Q* = 1.0e-7 exactly; U_m = 0.010 m/s, Re_h = 6.67

NULL.note: zero fan curve; flow driven by environmental total pressure alone: Q* = p0_env/R = 1.5e-7 exactly, same analytic operating point as curve A with the fan contribution removed

I1.quantity: max over fan-patch faces of |p_f - (p0_env + dp(Q_meas) - 0.5*neg(phi_f)*|U_f|^2)| [m2/s2], Q_meas = -sum(phi_fan)
I1.why_tol: identity exact in exact arithmetic (fanPressureFvPatchScalarField.cxx:144-205 + totalPressureFvPatchScalarField.cxx:191); floor = last-iteration flux lag (bounded by the bit-identical-checkpoint gate at writePrecision 12, <~1e-11 rel) + ascii rounding (~1e-13 abs); 8.1e-8 = 1e-6 * 0.081 sits >=3 decades above that floor and 3 decades below the static-vs-total convention-error signature 0.5*U_m^2 = 1.125e-4
I1.falsifier: any face residual > 8.1e-8; a residual of order 1.1e-4 names the static-vs-total convention error the curriculum warns about

I2.why_tol: SIMPLE writes the conservative corrected flux; imbalance inherits the p-solve closure (tolerance 1e-10, relTol 0) whose normalisation is opaque from outside, so the floor is registered generous; the defect this row exists to catch (leaking patch, reader bug) shows at O(1) relative

P1.quantity: number of fan-patch faces with phi >= 0 at endTime
P1.falsifier: any outflow face on the fan patch voids the analytic energy-balance referent: G1/G2/N1/D1 become NOT A RESULT (I1/I2 still graded)

R1.quantity: observed order p of the F_c/F_m/F_f triple on Q*
R1.falsifier: p outside [1.6,2.4] -> GATE FAIL; triple not CONVERGING -> NOT A RESULT, value+triple+order printed, no GCI quoted on non-monotone values; any level not converged/plateaued -> NOT A RESULT
R1.basis: derived wall-discretisation law dev(Q*) = +1/Ny^2 (level-independent entrance term cancels in differences): e32/e21 = (1/64-1/144)/(1/144-1/324) = 2.2500 exactly at the leading order, p = ln(2.25)/ln(1.5) = 2.000

G1.quantity: Q* of F_f at endTime vs exact 1.5e-7
G1.falsifier: outside the interval; requires F_f converged and P1; independent of R1's triple state (its interval is analytic, not GCI-derived)
G1.basis: wall-discretisation dev = (2/Ny^2)*R/(R+2 k2 Q*) = 1/18^2 = +0.3086% (the 2/N^2 law is derived and selftested; the factor is R/(R+2k2Q*) = 0.5 for curve A) - entrance+KE term kappa*(U_m^2/2)/((R+2 k2 Q*)*Q*), kappa = alpha_out(54/35=1.5429)+kappa_e, kappa_e in [0,1] central 0.35 -> -0.197% [-0.265,-0.161]; +/-0.15% margin for unmodelled x-discretisation

G2.quantity: Q* of S_f at endTime vs exact 1.0e-7
G2.falsifier: outside the interval; requires S_f converged and P1

N1.quantity: Q of N_f at endTime vs exact 1.5e-7 (zero-fan null: pressure-difference-driven alone)
N1.falsifier: outside the interval; requires N_f converged and P1. Structural registered prediction: the null's wall term is +2/Ny^2 = +0.617%, double the fan case's, because with no fan slope the factor R/(R+2k2Q*) is 1
N1.basis: +2/18^2 = +0.617% wall term - entrance term kappa*1.125e-4/0.054, central -0.394% [-0.530,-0.321]; +/-0.20% margin (double sensitivity)

D1.kind: reported diagnostic, graded as a prediction about a diagnostic (T10aR RX5 class)
D1.quantity: sign-corrected Richardson extrapolate of the F triple vs exact 1.5e-7
D1.falsifier: outside the interval; in particular a Richardson landing at ~0 dev falsifies the registered entrance model low. NOT A RESULT if R1's triple is not CONVERGING. Grades no case row; uses the exact reference and is not an instrument independent of the hypothesis

Z1.kind: planted-zero control (rule 3, T10aR SS2.2 exact-float rule)
Z1.quantity: recovered change from a plant into a scratch copy of a checkpoint field, read back through the same reader
Z1.falsifier: any mismatch is a comparator REFUSAL (exit 2), not a graded row

cost.basis: T1c-class ladder replicates L_Ts_P_c/m/f (T1_runs STATUS files): 4000 cells/30000 it/809 s, 10240/30000/2221 s, 26112/30000/5844 s -> 6.7-7.5e-6 s per cell-iteration (buoyantBoussinesqSimpleFoam, contended box); 7.5e-6 used as the conservative basis for a cheaper solver
cost.per_case_stop: any case exceeding 10x its predicted wall is stopped and investigated, not waited out
cost.actual_note: filled at process completion only, never at registration (Sanaa 2026-08-23 estimate-vs-actual law, CLAUDE.md rule 12)
